title: Expected indicator under a deterministic assignment
statement: Let $D$ be a finite set, let a constraint template on $D$ specify a finite family of predicates with arities and Boolean evaluations, and let $c$ be one of its constraints on a set of variables. For any assignment $x$ of values in $D$ to the variables, if each variable is independently sampled from the point mass at its assigned value, then the expected satisfaction indicator of $c$ equals $1$ when $c$ is satisfied by $x$ and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A constraint template on $D$ is given
$c$ is a constraint for that template
$x$ assigns an element of $D$ to each variable
